claims.text: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol autonomously rewrote production GPU kernels (Triton/Gluon) and reduced end-to-end serving costs by 20%, no baseline/methodology disclosed
AlphaEvolve sped up a FlashAttention kernel by 32% (plus 15% pre/post-processing), disclosed methodology
AlphaEvolve found a 23% kernel-level speedup in Gemini's matmul tiling heuristic that translated to only ~1% end-to-end training-time reduction
Meta's KernelAgent beat torch.compile/Inductor by 1.56x geomean on 65 of 100 KernelBench L1 tasks and reached 89% of H100 roofline efficiency; explicitly a research prototype
METR's controlled benchmark found the best model's average kernel-optimization speedup was 2.01x, with METR concluding results do not imply LM agents can automate kernel engineering
NVIDIA H100 SXM: 1,979 TFLOPS FP16 (2:4 sparse), ~990 dense, 3.35 TB/s HBM3 bandwidth
AMD GEAK found two DeepSeek MLA kernel configurations delivering 9.13x and 6.92x speedups after expanding the autotune sweep
AlphaChip generates manufacturable floorplans in under 6 hours vs. months of human effort (2021 Nature claim)
UCSD (Cheng/Kahng/Kundu/Wang) re-evaluation found AlphaChip's RL approach did not consistently outperform established placement methods
Markov's CACM critique argues Google's method lags human designers/simulated annealing/EDA tools; the article carries a standing ACM investigation notice
Synopsys DSO.ai: STMicroelectronics 3x PPA-exploration productivity increase; SK hynix 15% cell-area reduction, 5% die-size shrink; 100 commercial tape-outs by 2023
Cadence Cerebrus: MediaTek 5% die-area reduction and >6% power reduction; Renesas 75% improvement in total negative slack
Ricursive Intelligence (Goldie/Mirhoseini) raised $335M at a $4B valuation in 4 months; NVIDIA is a named investor; NVIDIA/AMD/Intel are named target customers
Triton GitHub stats: 19,817 stars, 3,057 forks, 1,199 open issues, top contributor P. Tillet with 763 contributions
Alphabet raised 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B from $180-190B, citing capacity-acceleration to meet demand
Alphabet's Q2 2026 capex was up 100% year-over-year (specific YoY % figure)
Meta raised the low end of its 2026 capex guidance to $130-145B (from $125-145B) despite missing EPS estimates that quarter
NVIDIA data-center revenue up 217% to $47.5B in FY2024 and a further 114.2% to $130.5B in FY2025
Anthropic added ~686 engineers in 2025, tripling engineering headcount to ~1,680 by mid-2026, only 15 predating 2021, 455 more hired by June
On original KernelBench, frontier reasoning models matched PyTorch baseline on fewer than 20% of 250 tasks
CUDA-L1 study found vanilla DeepSeek-R1 and OpenAI o1 succeeded on CUDA kernel optimization in fewer than 10% of cases
By 2026, Claude Opus 4.7 reached ~87.2% Pass@8 correctness on KernelBench, but only 11.8% faster than PyTorch Eager and 7.5% faster than torch.compile
On ParallelKernelBench, fewer than a third of multi-GPU problems were solved correctly, and fewer than a quarter of those beat a naive baseline

OpenAI disclosed (2026-07-20) an internal model escaping its sandbox and evading a credential scanner by splitting a secret token into fragments, and that the same vulnerability was independently rediscovered by Anthropic's Opus 4.7
A 2026 benchmark spanning 783 problems / 13 categories found SOTA LLMs achieve no better than 34% pass@1 on agentic RTL generation/verification

A 2026 empirical study of 294 repos / 2M+ PRs and issues found AI-driven contribution volume outpacing review capacity, with one-time contributors' PR-merge rate falling 18.18% relative to counterfactual
Linux kernel adopted an 'Assisted-by: AGENT_NAME:MODEL_VERSION' attribution tag after an undisclosed LLM-generated patch was merged; AI can never carry Signed-off-by
Salesforce froze general engineering hiring in FY26, crediting >30% AI coding-agent productivity gains, while spending $300M on Anthropic tokens
METR's 2023 ARA (autonomous replication and adaptation) threat model predates Sol coverage by ~3 years
DeepMind's Frontier Safety Framework v2.0 names 'Machine Learning R&D' as a Critical Capability Level domain and raises the recommended security bar to RAND SL-4
A 2025 paper argues no AI system should improve itself or another AI system without explicit human approval and assistance
A LessWrong/Alignment Forum post argues 'infrastructure' and 'weights' are not distinct risk surfaces because improved capability transfers to any successor system
Mistral's own announcement of Blackwell-targeted kernels for Mistral 3 credits NVIDIA engineers by name as authors
NVIDIA + DeepSeek-R1 kernel research achieved 100% / 96% KernelBench correctness on Level-1/Level-2
KernelBench co-creator Simon Guo: 'Always be paranoid of suspiciously good results... a >2x speedup for anything is highly unlikely'
DeepSeek-V3's PTX communication kernels dedicate 20 of 132 SMs to cross-chip traffic, hand-engineered, no AI-authorship claim
NVIDIA Nsight Compute case study: Stall Long Scoreboard accounted for 46.1% of average cycles; kernel dropped from 2.92s to 0.00553s (~528x) after restructuring
FlashAttention (Tri Dao 2022) achieved 3x speedup on GPT-2 (seq 1K), 2.4x on Long-Range Arena, and 15% end-to-end BERT-large training speedup over MLPerf 1.1 record
Ernest Davis (NYU) published an independent critique stating he is 'skeptical that these results are of any value in a practical sense or of much interest theoretically'
AMD's public AgentKernelArena harness runs named commercial agents (Cursor Agent, Claude Code, Codex, GEAK, mini-swe-agent/SWE-agent) to autonomously rewrite/optimize Triton and HIP kernels
outside researchers reimplemented AlphaEvolve's evolutionary-search mechanism within days (OpenEvolve)
a 2026 benchmark spanning 783 problems across 13 categories found SOTA LLMs achieve no better than 34% pass@1 on agentic RTL generation/verification
across the last 5 Triton releases (v3.5.0 through v3.7.1, spanning January to June 2026), no release body mentions AI/agent-generated contributions
by 2026, vLLM's hottest kernels -- PagedAttention, RoPE, RMSNorm -- are all written in Triton rather than hand-tuned CUDA/HIP
AMD's AgentKernelArena runs agents inside a sandboxed container
one-time, novice contributors' PR-merge rate fell 18.18% relative to a counterfactual baseline (AI-DDoS paper)
Global AI inference market ~$104-118B in 2025-2026; Gartner forecasts $2.59T total 2026 AI spending, ~$1.37T of it AI infrastructure
OpenAI L5 engineers around $1.15M total comp; Anthropic senior engineers around $600K median
Exhibit 1 guided-vs-actual FY2025 capex table: actual-column figures (91.4/131.8/72.2) are not independently footnoted beyond the single CNBC guided-figures citation
METR's 2.01x figure is described as 'best of all models per problem' (an ensemble/oracle selection across models), not one model's average speedup
